description: Container versions, newest first: version ID, name, entity counts, and which one is live (published). Pass a version_id to get_container, diff or the get_* tools to read an older version.

account_id.description: Numeric Tag Manager account ID, from list_accounts.

container_id.description: Numeric container ID from list_containers, or the public ID ("GTM-XXXXXXX").

include_deleted.description: Also list deleted versions. Default false.

limit.description: How many versions to return. Default 50.

name: list_versions
title: List container versions
